create_budget_new: create a new LiteLLM budget with max_budget, soft_budget, budget_duration, and optional model-specific limits
update_budget_existing: update an existing LiteLLM budget identified by budget_id with new max_budget or duration values
get_budget_info: get information for one or more LiteLLM budgets by passing a list of budget ids
list_all_budgets: list all budgets stored in the LiteLLM proxy database
delete_budget: delete a LiteLLM budget from the proxy database by its budget id
